overall: MARGINAL overall: west/central fishable early, east too windy
limiterDetail: Main limiter is wind (east grounds 14–17 kt ≈ 26–31 kph, gusts 20–22) plus current at Tara/Turda (1.1–1.2 kt). Rain is minor and mostly dry. Wind builds through the day to 16 kt by 2 PM. 9.7 kt is about 18 kph, the line fishermen treat as bad.

pagasa.detail: PAGASA: CLEAR (feed OK, no gale/TCWS/heavy-rain alert for Calamian/MIMAROPA; latest items are Luzon/Cagayan advisories). Supporting only.

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed
items: Better than yesterday afternoon: 7 GOOD / 3 MARGINAL / 6 POOR / 0 VERY POOR. West/central grounds recovered to GOOD (Culion, Linapacan, Alava). East grounds (Nangalao, Cabunlawan, Decabaitot, Ciron) stay POOR on wind; Tara and Turda stay POOR on current 1.1–1.2 kt. Today Wed 25 is the roughest day (POOR / BELOW NORMAL: 16 kt ≈ 30 kph, gusts 23). Thu 26 is now MARGINAL / normal → softening (was POOR). No surge.
PAGASA is CLEAR for Calamian/MIMAROPA. Shortage detector ELEVATED Wed–Tue (guide only). Season ends about 6 Dec.

shortageRisk: Surge flag OFF. Shortage detector ELEVATED (Wed–Tue, guide only). Tightening risk: today and tomorrow, east grounds all week. West and central supply should hold better. No surge expected.

bestWindow.headline: Now to ~9 AM today, west and central grounds
details: Wind is lowest right now (about 6 AM: Coron/Galoc 6.9 kt) and climbs to 15–16 kt by 2 PM for west/central grounds, 20 kt gusts at east grounds by 10–11 AM. Best grounds: Coron, Galoc, Culion, Linapacan, Panlaitan, Maglalambay, Alava. Tara/Turda current peaks 1.3–1.5 kt around 8 AM; Decabaitot, Barangonan and Alava pulse after midnight. Keep small boats off Nangalao, Cabunlawan, Decabaitot and Ciron.
